INSERT INTO alteration (
                authored_at, start_date, days, absence, zone, reason
            )
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT (start_date) DO UPDATE
                SET authored_at = excluded.authored_at,
                    days        = excluded.days,
                    absence     = excluded.absence,
                    zone        = excluded.zone,
                    reason      = excluded.reason
            RETURNING id
